description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: %p-subst-compiled (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) keeps the translated pattern in the op's holder only when the p-subst macro proved the pattern and flags constant (its docstring); an interpolated pattern gets a fresh holder, so perl-regex-to-ppcre runs per call.  Perl recompiles an interpolated pattern only when the interpolated STRING changes.

PROFILES (sb-sprof :cpu over the run, scratch/s541a/prof-c1fe4930/): perl-regex-to-ppcre inclusive -- YAML-PP 43.indent.t 43.8 %, 20.dump.t 32.2 % (and 21.emit.t's %p-subst-compiled 55 %), Mojo-DOM58 dom.t 50.4 % (cl-ppcre:regex-replace-all 39 % under it), Data-Dumper pair.t 23.8 %; Text-CSV 55_combi.t 10 % of its allocation.  Board seconds ~2.5-3 s (YAML-PP ~2 s of its 5.7 s run, Mojo 0.3 s, the rest small) -- and every text program with a pattern in a variable.

DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (TAKEN, scratch/s541a/micro/m-interpre.pl, listbench.log): 20,000 x `s/$p/Z/` with $p constant: perl 4.6 ms, PCL 63.5 ms (13.7x); 20,000 x `/$p/` (the cached m// path): perl 2.65 ms, PCL 7.2 ms (2.7x).  After the fix the s/// row should read near the m// row.

LEVER: a per-SITE memo of (interpolated string, flags) -> translated pattern / scanner, as m// has; invalidate on a different string.  Size: one session.
subject: PERF: an s/// whose PATTERN is interpolated re-translates it (perl-regex-to-ppcre: six regex-replace-all passes) on EVERY call -- %p-subst-compiled caches only a constant pattern, m// caches the interpolated one; YAML-PP 32-44 % of its runs, Mojo-DOM58 dom.t 50 %; s/$p/Z/ 13.7x perl
